canonical_handwritten.predicate: handwritten == true AND scope_api == fsr_read AND canonical_default_included == true
canonical_handwritten.description: Primary borrowed fixed-width/codepoint representations and aliases/layout providers; original project handwritten functions, excluding generated files and non-handwritten vendor/compiler/backport bodies.

canonical_default_core.description: Same primary representation scope, all origins accepted by canonical default file selection, including vendor generic algorithms, compiler/runtime, CPython copy/backport and SIP runtime.

core_all_origins.description: Primary representation scope plus excluded generated-file and compatibility-file supplements.

all_inventory.description: All preceding scopes plus legacy wchar/pointer APIs, caller-owned UCS4 copies, UTF8 byte/cache consumers, remote raw layout, test consumers and source operands of write APIs.

canonical_default_file_selection: Exclude basename pythoncapi_compat.h and files whose first line matches the frozen Cython-generated marker. Semantic exclusions still apply within every file.
count_unit: One source function keyed by package/version/archive path/function_start. Package category sets and B subtype tags overlap.
not_an_fsr_requirement_count: B includes fixed scalar reads and monotonic current-cursor continuations; no automatic cache requirement follows.
